0022600168.text: The Utah Jazz (1-4, 12th in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (3-2, 8th in the West) with Utah on a three-game losing streak and San Antonio on a three-game winning streak. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Jazz trail the season series 0-1 after a 117-111 loss in Salt Lake City on October 28, and they lost their 2025-26 series 1-2.
